about.label: About
about.title: Engineer by trade.
about.lead: I'm Bassem, a software engineer based in southern France. I care about the entire path from a real problem to software people enjoy using.
about.body1: Coding has been a constant since I discovered it early on. Working with different teams and teaching others has shaped how I think about architecture, good practices, and the value of changing your mind.
about.body2: I like crossing boundaries between front end, back end, and infrastructure. The best products happen when engineers understand their users, own their decisions, and stay curious about the whole system.

experience.title: Where I've made
